methodology: Main-thread synchronous embed(), identical repeated input per case, 300ms warmup per case, calibrated ~250ms batches, median of 5 rounds; load excluded from throughput. Long input is 280 words; WordPiece count not measured.

cases.name: Short
cases.text: Fast local text search works well.

cases.name: Medium
cases.text: A small static embedding model turns this sentence into a useful vector directly on the user's device.

cases.name: Long
cases.text: A static embedding model uses a compact vocabulary lookup table to quickly represent text as a normalized semantic vector without a neural network or a remote inference service.
